use bstr::{ByteSlice,ByteVec};
fn main(){
 let original:Vec<u8>=(0..=255).collect();
 let escaped=original.escape_bytes().to_string();
 assert_eq!(Vec::unescape_bytes(&escaped),original);
 assert_eq!(Vec::unescape_bytes(r"hello\nworld\xFF"),b"hello\nworld\xFF");
 assert_eq!(Vec::unescape_bytes("snow: λ"),"snow: λ".as_bytes());
 assert_eq!(b"one two".find(b"two"),Some(4));
 println!("{} {}",original.len(),Vec::unescape_bytes("abc").to_str().unwrap());
}
